contract.task:
Export resolveOptions(base,override) from src/options.mjs. For own enumerable string keys, shallow-merge override into base, except undefined override values keep base values; undefined keys absent from base are omitted. Preserve null, false, zero and empty string as explicit values. Return a new object; never mutate inputs. Inherited keys must be ignored. Both inputs are plain objects.
Preserve existing exports and tests. Add at least one executable test in test/. Only src/ and test/ are writable; existing tests are protected.

questions.question: The registered `public-examples` check fails with `TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'value')` inside its own harness file (option-overlay.visible.mjs, outside the project I can only write to src/ and test/). The check appears to look up a named example and find it undefined — so the harness isn't surfacing the actual failing assertion against my export. Could you confirm the expected `resolveOptions` public-example behavior the check verifies (concretely which named example and inputs/expected output), so I can align my implementation with it?
